business_problem: This vision required Medtronic to innovate. Working from 70,000 data and analytics dashboards created by staff in different locations and functions, employees found it challenging to find the most accurate version of the data. The company wanted to unify these dashboards.
solution_summary: Medtronic built this solution on Power BI, Power Automate, Microsoft Copilot Studio. This vision required Medtronic to innovate. Working from 70,000 data and analytics dashboards created by staff in different locations and functions, employees found it challenging to find the most accurate version of the data. Power BI publishes dashboards and self-service analytics to business users. Power Automate runs workflow automations and approvals across connected systems. Microsoft Copilot Studio builds and manages conversational agents integrated with business workflows. Medtronic, a healthcare technology leader, adopted a “one best way” strategy to unify its Global Operations and Supply Chain (GO&SC) data and analytics under one team and used Microsoft Power BI to create an innovative c This team transformed thousands of dashboards with disparate data into a cohesive ecosystem, named INSIGHTS, by using Power BI to help create a single source of truth.
